# qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (vendored)

`public/vendor/qrcode-generator/1.4.4/qrcode.js` — copied unmodified from the npm
package `qrcode-generator@1.4.4` (Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence, notice in the file
header). Loaded only by `public/desktop-note.js`, on computers, to show a code that
opens the Popcode on a phone.

- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz
- sha256 `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`

To upgrade: download the new tarball, copy `package/qrcode.js` into a new version
folder, update the path in `desktop-note.js` (`QR_SRC`) and this file.
